# DS-04: Exploratory Data Analysis (Tier 1)

**Subtrack:** Data Science  
**Unit scope:** Systematic exploration, hypothesis generation, pitfalls such as Simpson's paradox, and documenting what the data can and cannot say.

## Assessments

Pick **any one**. Every assessment here is an independent, complete demonstration of this unit at this tier.

| ID | Title | Format | Domain | Est. time | Compute | Difficulty (T M R E A Res) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`DS-T1-009`](DS-T1-009-the-paradox-ward/README.md) | The Paradox Ward: Stratified Exploration of Hospital Outcome Rankings | Investigation | health, public-sector | 8–14 h | CPU, offline-capable | T2 M2 R1 E2 A2 R1 |

| [`DS-T1-011`](DS-T1-011-the-confident-notebook/README.md) | The Confident Notebook: Auditing the Claims of an Exploratory Analysis | Debugging & Forensics | fintech, mobile-money | 10–16 h | CPU, offline-capable | T2 M2 R1 E2 A3 R1 |

- **[DS-T1-009](DS-T1-009-the-paradox-ward/README.md): The Paradox Ward: Stratified Exploration of Hospital Outcome Rankings.** A draft hospital league table ranks the network's referral centre last on crude 30-day mortality. Stratify, standardise and decompose the rates to discover a Simpson's reversal, tell confounders from proxies and non-confounders, and advise the Commissioner on what the data can and cannot show.
- **[DS-T1-010](DS-T1-010-hours-on-the-feeder/README.md): Hours on the Feeder: Supply-Hours Exploration of Electricity Outage Logs.** Turn six months of messy control-room outage logs from a fictional Nigerian distribution company into defensible daily supply hours, then use dependence-aware bootstrap intervals to find which feeders are confidently failing their NERC service band and how naive processing distorts the answer.
- **[DS-T1-011](DS-T1-011-the-confident-notebook/README.md): The Confident Notebook: Auditing the Claims of an Exploratory Analysis.** Audit a polished but flawed exploratory notebook from a fictional mobile-money operator. For each of ten claims, decide whether the data supports it, name the flaw (survivorship, base rates, log scales, confounding, ecological fallacy, regression to the mean and more) and compute the correct figure.
